response.reason: The kernel replaces the exact dot products with per-row INT4 (absmax/7) quantization of both A and B. With ~N(0,1) rows (absmax≈2.9, step s≈0.41), per-element quantization error std ≈ s/sqrt(12)≈0.12, and since ||x||=1 each row's dot-product error std ≈0.12 per matrix (≈0.17 combined), while the reference row values are ≈1.0 by construction. This gives E ≈ 0.17 >> 0.1, and the 64-row averaging makes a lucky pass essentially impossible.
